airline_monthly.label: Airline monthly traffic
airline_monthly.grain: airline x fiscal month x segment (domestic | international)
airline_monthly.description: Scheduled traffic and operating statistics reported by Indian airlines to DGCA (ICAO ATR Form A). Fiscal years run April-March; the latest fiscal year is partial and recent months are provisional. Rows for aggregate entities (ALL SCHEDULED INDIAN AIRLINES, national, private) are totals of airlines and are excluded by default so nothing is double counted.

route_monthly.label: Domestic routes (city pairs)
route_monthly.grain: directed city pair x month (scheduled domestic services)
route_monthly.description: Passengers, freight and mail carried between pairs of Indian places, one row per direction per month, from DGCA's city-pair statistics (2015 onward; freight and mail only from 2018). "Origin" is where the flight departed. Summing both directions by Route gives the pair total. Three months are missing at the source (Mar-Apr 2018 are present; missing: Jun 2019, May 2021, May 2024). Not split by airline.

origin.label: Origin
origin.description: Place the passengers departed from (airport/city as published by DGCA; names harmonised).

origin_city.label: Origin city
origin_city.description: Groups airports serving one city (Mumbai + Navi Mumbai; the Goa airports).

route.label: Route (both directions)
route.description: Unordered city pair, e.g. Delhi – Mumbai; sums both directions.

airline.label: Airline
airline.description: Operator name (aliases merged, e.g. 'AIR ASIA excel' -> AirAsia India).

airline_type.label: Entity type
airline_type.description: Airline, or Aggregate for DGCA roll-ups (all scheduled / national / private).

month.label: Month
month.description: Calendar month, ordered April to March.

period.label: Month (timeline)
period.description: First day of the month; use for time series.

route_freight_t.label: Route freight (tonnes)
route_freight_t.description: Published from 2018; earlier months are blank, not zero.

pax_load_factor.label: Passenger load factor
pax_load_factor.description: Passenger-km / available seat-km. Recomputed from sums, never averaged.

known_issues.note: Jet Airways' monthly file for Apr-Dec 2015 is missing at the source (HTTP 403 on DGCA's file store), so airline totals for these months exclude Jet Airways (about 1.3 million passengers a month). City-pair totals are complete.
Published under the city-pair name but contains an airline/country list, not traffic data.
Available tonne-km months sum to 18,312.7 but the sheet's own total says 18,507.6 (1% off). Quarantined rather than guessing which is right.
January 2025 lists one 'Hyderabad to HYDERABAD' row (2 passengers). It is kept so the month still reconciles to the sheet total.
City-pair files are missing at the source for May 2021 and May 2024, and the file named 'June 2019' contains an unrelated airline list. Those three months have no route rows.
